study: Summit specification-guided vs code-only unit test generation
specification_provenance: Original user stories and Product Backlog; specific deployment clarification from project team

requirements.text: A registered user can log in using their email and password.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 1 user story: account creation and login; Product Backlog: Create an account and log in.

requirements.text: A user must complete the account verification-code step before they can log in.
requirements.evidence: Sprint 1 user story: verify email after registration; current user clarification: verification code entered manually after retrieval from server logs.

requirements.text: A successful login establishes an authenticated session.
requirements.evidence: Product Backlog: authentication with a login session; Sprint 1 user stories: persist authentication token during app session.

evaluation_notes: Email verification represents a manually entered code; do not assume outgoing email delivery.
